create_TrajectoryDataset: create a TrajectoryDataset to load motion planning trajectory data from a dataset directory with SDF and image files
use_TrajectoryDataset_get_all_files: use get_all_files to retrieve a dictionary of file paths organized by map type from the dataset
use_TrajectoryDataset_getitem: use __getitem__ to load a single sample with map tensor, SDF data, and expert trajectory tensors
generate_trajectory_figs: generate trajectory figures to visualize multiple robot paths overlaid on environment maps with optional SDF plots
use_add_robot_to_trajectory: use _add_robot_to_trajectory to overlay robot shapes as circles or triangles along a trajectory path
